mapper.select: select s.scenario_id, s.scenario_title, s.description, s.estimated_minutes, s.is_active (select c.category_name from category c where c.category_id = s.category_id) AS category_name from scenario s

select s.scenario_id, s.scenario_title, s.description, s.estimated_minutes, (select c.category_name from category c where c.category_id = s.category_id) AS category_name, (select count(*) from scenario_step ss where step_order>0 and ss.scenario_id = s.scenario_id ) AS step_count from scenario s where s.is_active=1
